channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Messias e PL da Dosimetria incendeiam direita e esquerda no caldeirão das redes sociais
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF and the overturning of Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetria Bill triggered massive social media mobilization, with the right celebrating these as blows to Lula's government and boosting Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, while the left condemned the Senate as anti-democratic and pushed for a Black woman to be nominated to the STF.

item.title: Saiba como votou cada parlamentar sobre derrubada do veto à dosimetria
item.description: The Brazilian Congress overturned President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which benefits those convicted of the January 8 attacks and former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL), potentially reducing their sentences. In the Chamber of Deputies, 318 voted to overturn the veto and 144 to uphold it; in the Senate, the vote was 49 to 24. This marks the second defeat for the Lula administration in under 24 hours, following the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Aliados de Lula querem limitar poder de veto do Senado
item.description: Allies of President Lula, through the Prerrogativas group, are preparing an ADPF before the STF to limit the Senate’s veto power over presidential nominations to the Supreme Court. The move follows the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias, former head of the AGU, for a seat on the Court. The goal is to reduce senatorial influence in the selection of STF justices, enhancing executive authority in judicial appointments.

item.title: Kátia Abreu chama Alcolumbre de Judas e apaga comentário
item.description: Former senator Kátia Abreu made an antisemitic comment against Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, comparing him to Judas Iscariot, and deleted the post after backlash. She later apologized, stating she did not intend to offend and had expressed herself poorly. The incident followed the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Lula deve anunciar ampliação da adição de etanol à gasolina
item.description: President Lula announced that the government will reveal next week an increase in ethanol blending in gasoline from 30% to 32% and biodiesel in diesel from 15% to 16%. The announcement was made during the launch of the second phase of Move Brasil at the Planalto Palace, aiming to strengthen Brazil's energy self-sufficiency. The change must be approved by the CNPE, whose next meeting is scheduled for early May.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Ideia sobre a disputa presidencial entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Ideia institute will release on Wednesday (6) a new presidential voting intention poll for 2026, based on 1,500 interviews with a 2.5 percentage point margin of error. The survey will test first and second-round scenarios, all featuring Lula (PT), with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as his main opponent. The previous April poll showed a technical tie between Lula and Flávio in a runoff, with Bolsonaro narrowly ahead.

item.title: Messias foi vítima de manipulação sórdida e mesquinha, diz Prerrogativas
item.description: The legal group Prerrogativas claims Jorge Messias was the victim of a sordid and petty manipulation in the defeat of his Supreme Court nomination by the Senate. The statement, released on April 30, 2026, alleges pressure and distortions during the confirmation process.

item.title: "Preciso estar lá": Endrick vê Copa do Mundo como prioridade absoluta
item.description: Endrick considers the 2026 World Cup an absolute priority and says he needs to be there. He stresses that his current focus is performing well at Lyon to secure a spot on the Brazil national team, noting that every opportunity is decisive. Despite pressure and doubts from Ancelotti’s comments, he remains focused on performance and consistency to help Brazil.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral conclui atualização tecnológica dos portais, reforçando modernização e segurança
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court completed the technological update of the Electoral Justice portals to the latest version of the Plone content management platform, strengthening security, performance, and availability of digital services. The migration, carried out from April 17 to 19, 2026, processed over 1.2 million contents from the TSE and all Regional Electoral Courts (TREs), introducing new visual elements to the TSE Portal and involving technical and business teams. The effort is part of the Electoral Justice’s ongoing initiative to deliver more modern, reliable, and user-friendly platforms while preserving information security and service availability.

item.title: STF dará palavra final sobre PL da Dosimetria, com chance de acirrar desgaste com Congresso
item.description: The STF will rule on the constitutionality of the Dosimetry Bill, which reduces sentences for January 8th rioters, after Congress overruled Lula’s veto. The judgment comes amid rising institutional tension, especially following the Senate’s rejection of Lula’s nominee Jorge Messias to the STF, seen as an attempt to weaken the Court. Justices are divided, and the decision could worsen the institutional crisis between the STF and Congress.

item.title: Decisão sobre eleição no Rio volta ao TSE após recurso
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will have to decide whether the resignation of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) was a fraudulent maneuver to avoid impeachment and maintain his political group in power through an indirect election in the state legislature. The coalition led by Marcelo Freixo filed a resource arguing that the TSE was remiss in not analyzing whether the resignation was spurious, which could invalidate the interim election and require a popular vote. Castro was convicted of illegally hiring 27,600 temporary workers in 2022, used as electoral operatives, and although not formally impeached, he faces ineligibility until 2030.

item.title: Lula anuncia pacote de R$ 22 bilhões para caminhoneiros
item.description: President Lula announced a R$ 22 billion package for the Move Brasil program, with R$ 14.5 billion from the National Treasury and R$ 6.7 billion from BNDES, aimed at renewing the truck and bus fleet, including R$ 2 billion exclusively for autonomous truckers. The announcement took place at the first Brazil-Spain Summit, marking his first public appearance since the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias, a topic he avoided mentioning. The initiative seeks to reconcile the government with truckers, a historically skeptical segment aligned with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Lula: Razão pela qual é preciso existir governo é para resolver problemas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the reason for the existence of the federal government is to solve problems, during the announcement of the Mover 2 program, which provides new credit for the purchase of trucks and buses.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica Lula e discursa em tom de campanha em sessão do Congresso
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the presidency, delivered a campaign-style speech during the joint session of Congress that overturned the presidential veto on the Dosimetry bill. He criticized President Lula and used the moment to position himself as an alternative to the current administration.

item.title: Lula ignora derrota histórica na indicação de Messias em cerimônia com ministros no Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ignored his government’s historic defeat in the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court during a ceremony at the Palácio do Planalto with ministers. Despite the rejection the previous night, Lula maintained a tone of normality without referencing the setback. The episode marks one of the government’s biggest setbacks in its relationship with Congress.

item.title: Voto no exterior: como regularizar o título até 6 de maio para votar nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Brazilians living abroad can vote in the 2026 elections only for president, provided they regularize their voter title by May 6. The process is done online via the TSE’s self-service system, requiring a photo ID, proof of overseas residence, and for men aged 18–45, a military discharge certificate. Voting is permitted only at Brazilian embassies or consulates authorized as electoral sections, following prior transfer of electoral domicile.

item.title: ‘Grave retrocesso para a democracia’, diz presidente do PT sobre rejeição a veto da Dosimetria
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva denounced the congressional overturning of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill as a 'serious setback for democracy,' claiming Congress ignored public opinion by reducing penalties for January 8 participants. The bill allows sentence reductions of one-third to two-thirds for those acting in a 'crowd context' without financing or leadership roles, which Edinho said could cut Bolsonaro’s potential sentence from over 27 years to about 2 years and 4 months. He argued the move weakens legal order and downplays the gravity of the institutional rupture attempt.

item.title: Lindbergh reage à derrubada de veto da dosimetria: "Acordão da impunidade"
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) criticized the overturning of the presidential veto on the Dosimetry Bill, calling it an 'impunity pact' that would benefit January 8 coup plotters and politicians tied to Banco Master, possibly including Jair Bolsonaro. He declared the bill unconstitutional and announced he would take the matter to the Supreme Federal Court (STF).

item.title: 'Congresso inimigo do povo': esquerda resgata lema após rejeição de Messias no Senado
item.description: Following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF and the overturning of Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill, government allies revived the slogan 'Congress is the enemy of the people' on social media. Legislators including Rick Azevedo (PSOL-RJ), Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Taliria Petrone (PSOL-RJ) condemned the Senate's decision, linking it to Bolsonarist influence and the protection of privileges. Councilman Pedro Rousseff (PT-MG) claimed the vote against Messias was an attempt to undermine Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Ministro Nunes Marques assume Presidência do TSE em 12 de maio
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques will assume the Presidency of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on May 12 at 7 p.m. in Brasília, with André Mendonça as vice-president. His term will focus on preparing for the 2026 General Elections, strengthening electronic voting security, and combating disinformation, following the seniority rule among STF justices serving on the TSE.

item.title: Lula não deve reagir à derrota histórica no Senado com demissão de ministros indicados por Alcolumbre, dizem aliados
item.description: Lula is not expected to dismiss ministers Waldez Góes and Frederico de Siqueira Filho, appointed by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, following the historic rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF. Allies say Lula prefers to let tensions subside, valuing the ministers’ performance and their rapport with the Civil House. He also ruled out nominating Rodrigo Pacheco to the STF to avoid yielding to Senate pressure and upholding presidential prerogative.

item.title: Lula mira caminhoneiros e lança Move Brasil com R$ 21,2 bi em crédito
item.description: President Lula's government launched the second phase of the Move Brasil program, allocating R$21.2 billion in credit for truck, bus, and road equipment purchases, with R$14.5 billion from the Treasury and R$6.7 billion from BNDES. The package includes R$2 billion for independent truckers, 12-month grace period, up to 10-year repayment terms, reduced interest rates, and plans to build 41 new truck rest stops by end-2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Deixaram Boulos sozinho no Acre
item.description: Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos (PSOL), criticized the absence of Acre’s Governor Mailza Assis (PP) and Rio Branco Mayor Alysson Lins at the inauguration of the 'Governo do Brasil na Rua' program in Acre, calling it 'politicagem'. He demanded institutional presence to ensure the program reaches local communities. The event took place on Wednesday, the 29th, and was reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: TSE cassa mandato de deputada do PL por pagar harmonização facial com dinheiro público
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously revoked the mandate of federal deputy Silvia Waiãpi (PL-AP) for using R$ 9,000 from the electoral fund to pay for a facial harmonization procedure in 2022, constituting an illicit use of campaign resources. The decision upheld the ruling of the TRE-AP after finding that the deputy falsified invoices to conceal the true use of public funds, violating transparency and electoral legality.

item.title: Oito a cada dez brasileiros são contra as Bets, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll shows 86.7% of Brazilians view online betting (bets) as harmful to society, with 63.2% saying they bring only harms and 23.5% more harms than benefits. Although online betting was legalized in 2018 under Temer’s government, 35.3% blame Lula’s administration for its spread, while 70% support banning bets and 80% favor higher taxes on the sector.

item.title: Janones ironiza “voto impresso” após rejeição de Messias no Senado
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) posted on X (formerly Twitter) mocking supporters of printed voting, following the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias via electronic vote on April 29, 2026. Janones sarcastically said he would wait for the 'flat earth crowd' to demand printed and auditable ballots, targeting right-wing lawmakers who oppose electronic voting machines despite using them to vote against Messias. The comment was seen as a provocation toward claims of electoral fraud in Brazil.

item.title: Calendário pré-eleitoral dificultaria análise de novo indicado ao STF no Senado
item.description: The pre-electoral calendar of the National Congress would make it nearly impossible to analyze a new STF nominee, as lawmakers will be absent due to June festivals and local election campaigns. Following the Senate’s resounding rejection of Jorge Messias, the Lula government is split between pushing immediately to assert presidential prerogative or delaying the nomination to let tensions subside. The likely outcome is that any new nominee remains in limbo until after the 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo Lula amplia programa para financiar compra de caminhões e ônibus
item.description: The Lula government expanded the Move Brasil program to include financing for buses, minibuses, and road implements, with a budget of R$21.2 billion and interest rates between 13% and 14% per year. The BNDES will operate the line, offering up to 10-year repayment terms and up to 12 months of grace period, with R$2 billion reserved exclusively for autonomous transporters. Funds are restricted to nationally manufactured vehicles meeting local content rules, and the measure also allows the purchase of used vehicles for autonomous drivers and cooperatives.

item.title: Lula anuncia novo financiamento para compra de caminhões e ônibus
item.description: President Lula announced the expansion of the Move Brasil program, now called Move Brasil 2, with R$ 21.2 billion in financing for the renewal of truck and bus fleets. The package includes R$ 2 billion for autonomous truckers and R$ 2 billion for bus lines, featuring improved conditions: grace period extended from 6 to 12 months, payment term increased from 5 to 10 years, and reduced interest rates. The initiative aims to meet high demand from the program’s first phase and regain support from truckers, a demographic historically aligned with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Deputado vai ao STF para obrigar Alcolumbre a instalar CPMI do Master
item.description: Deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) filed a security writ with the STF to compel Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) to install the Master CPMI, alleging Alcolumbre violated the Internal Regulations by failing to read the CPMI request during the joint congressional session on April 30, 2026, which was reserved only for Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetry Bill. Kataguiri requests the case be assigned to Minister André Mendonça and cites the STF precedent that ordered the opening of the Covid-19 CPI as basis for the injunction.

item.title: Magno Malta é internado após desmaiar a caminho da votação do veto do PL da dosimetria no Senado
item.description: Senator Magno Malta (PL-ES) was hospitalized after fainting in the Senate parking lot while en route to vote on the presidential veto of the Dosimetria Bill. He received medical attention at the Senate clinic and was transferred to DF Star Hospital, where he underwent a CT scan and reported improvement. Although absent from the session, he celebrated the veto's overthrow (49-24), which reduces penalties for January 8th participants and benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eleitor em Dia: brasileiros no exterior podem votar nas Eleições 2026
item.description: Brazilians living abroad can vote in the 2026 elections only for the offices of President and Vice President of the Republic, provided they regularize their electoral status by May 6. Services such as issuing the first voter title, updating data, and transferring electoral domicile can be completed entirely online via the TSE’s Online Electoral Self-Service. Over 800,000 Brazilians overseas are currently eligible to vote.

item.title: Zé Dirceu aponta “aliança pela impunidade” entre Alcolumbre e Flávio
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) of forming an 'impunity alliance' by overturning the veto on the dosimetry bill, suggesting the move aimed to shield personal or political interests.

item.title: Prazos processuais ficam suspensos no feriado do Dia do Trabalho
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will not hold sessions on Friday, May 1st, due to the national Labor Day holiday. Procedural deadlines beginning or ending on that day are automatically extended to Monday, May 4th, the next business day, as established by TSE Ordinance No. 533/2025.

item.title: Após derrotas no Congresso, líder do PT na Câmara diz que não é hora de retaliações
item.description: PT Chamber leader Pedro Uczai opposed retaliation following the rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF, arguing the best response is to continue governing and nominate a new candidate—possibly a woman—for the vacancy. He warned that identifying 'traitors' or removing political appointees only deepens conflict, stressing that institutional dialogue between Lula and Alcolumbre is key to rebuilding government support in the Senate.

item.title: Organizações sociais criticam derrubada de veto ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Civil society organizations criticized the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetria bill, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 coup attempt. They argue the move constitutes an institutional setback, normalizes political violence, and risks enabling impunity for future attacks on democracy.

item.title: Senac amplia parcerias com vagas gratuitas em comércio exterior e economia criativa
item.description: Senac expanded its partnerships with the federal government to offer free courses in foreign trade and the creative economy, targeting socially vulnerable populations. In the creative economy, a national self-instructional online program in Cultural Project Management was launched, offering 3,800 free slots for CadÚnico registrants, covering topics such as cultural production, grant writing, resource mobilization, and digital marketing. In foreign trade, the agreement with MDIC led to a new edition of the Raízes Comex program, providing 400 free slots focused on the productive inclusion of Black Brazilians.

item.title: Magno Malta sofre mal súbito e é internado em hospital de Brasília
item.description: Senator Magno Malta (PL-ES) suffered a sudden medical episode on the morning of April 30, 2026, and was rushed to DF Star Hospital in Brasília due to low blood pressure. He lost consciousness upon arriving at Congress to attend a session but is under stable clinical observation with no serious complications. His hospitalization occurred on the same day Congress overturned President Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill and rejected Jorge Messias’s nomination to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Violento ataque à democracia, diz Lindbergh sobre PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) labeled the overturning of President Lula's vetoes on the Dosimetria Bill as a 'violent attack on Brazilian democracy', also criticizing Senate President Davi Alcolumbre's role. The bill, which reduces penalties for coup attempts and abolition of the rule of law, was approved by Congress on April 30, 2026, overriding Lula's January veto. The measure may benefit former President Jair Bolsonaro, as 850 people have already been convicted for the January 8 attacks.

item.title: Indicação de ministra negra ao STF por Lula é “ato de reparação e, agora, jogada de mestre”, considera coletivo Mulheres Negras Decidem
item.description: The Black Women Decide collective urges President Lula to appoint a Black female jurist to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), arguing that after the Senate rejected Jorge Messias’ nomination, appointing a Black woman is no longer just about diversity but about institutional survival. The group views the move as both a historical act of reparation and a strategic political masterstroke.

item.title: Depois de rejeição histórica pelo Senado, Lula poderia indicar Messias novamente para o STF?
item.description: The historic rejection of Jorge Messias by the Senate for a Supreme Court seat prevents his re-nomination for the same position during this legislative term, due to Senate Internal Act 1/2010, which bars re-submission of rejected nominations within the same legislative session. Since the legislative session ends in December and resumes in February, a new nomination for Messias could only occur after the 2026 elections, if Lula is re-elected. This rule is an internal Senate norm and not subject to judicial review.

item.title: Flávio celebra derrubada de veto do PL da Dosimetria: “Primeiro passo”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) celebrated the congressional override of President Lula's veto on the dosimetry bill, calling it a 'first step' toward delivering full justice to those persecuted over the January 8, 2023, acts. He framed the defeat of the PT in this vote as progress in the fight against what he describes as political persecution.

item.title: Messias agradece manifestações de apoio de André Mendonça e Gilmar Mendes após rejeição no Senado
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias thanked the support of Supreme Court Ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes after his nomination to the STF was rejected by the Senate by a vote of 42 to 34. He described Mendonça's support as one of the greatest honors of his life and praised Mendes' affectionate words, emphasizing his continued commitment to justice and independence.

item.title: PL da Dosimetria: Veja como o Congresso votou para derrubada de veto de Lula
item.description: Congress overturned President Lula’s veto on a bill that reduces penalties for those involved in the January 8, 2023 anti-democratic acts, benefiting former President Jair Bolsonaro. The vote was 318–144 in the Chamber and 49–24 in the Senate, exceeding the required majority. Government-aligned parties such as PSD, PDT, and PSB supported the override, while the MDB allowed its senators to vote freely.

item.title: Dosimetria: novas penas para o 8 de Janeiro passarão pelo STF
item.description: Congress overturned the presidential veto on the Dosimetria Bill, which flexibilizes sentences for those convicted of the January 8 attacks, allowing sentence reductions and faster progression to open regimes, subject to STF approval. The move, led by opposition figure Flávio Bolsonaro, was seen as a government defeat and used to bolster claims of political persecution. The bill, passed in December 2025, now awaits implementation by the penalty execution court under Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Líder do MDB no Senado nega ação contra Messias e acusa governo de buscar ‘bode expiatório’
item.description: The leader of the MDB in the Senate, Eduardo Braga, denied that the party's bloc acted against the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court, calling the accusations 'intrigue' and 'malice'. He accused the government of seeking a 'scapegoat' for the defeat and stated that the MDB maintained favorable dialogue with the nomination, reaffirming its commitment to the allied base, provided there is mutual loyalty.

item.title: PT chama de 'retrocesso' rejeição a veto da Dosimetria e diz que decisão 'ignora' tentativa de golpe
item.description: PT national president Edinho Silva condemned the overturning of President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill as a 'serious setback' for democracy, arguing it pardons those who planned the January 8 coup attempts. He stated the bill, while not a direct amnesty, could reduce sentences for those convicted—including former president Jair Bolsonaro—and accused Congress of ignoring the institutional rupture attempt.

item.title: Gleisi: rejeição a Messias é oportunidade para debater indicação de mulher ao STF
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) stated that the rejection of Jorge Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) presents an opportunity to appoint a woman to the Court. She argued that the selection should reflect gender diversity and representativeness in the Judiciary.

item.title: Fantasma de 'Lula encastelado' volta a rondar Planalto após 'não' a Messias
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court renewed criticism of President Lula for his allegedly 'entrenched' posture, causing discomfort within the Palácio do Planalto. The decision was interpreted as a sign of political fragility and government isolation from Congress.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro comemora rejeição de Messias no Senado: 'Justiça de Deus foi feita'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, stating that 'God's justice was done'. She shared a post from Senator Marcio Bittar (PL-AC) on social media, highlighting the vote outcome as a victory.
